notes: There are 29 endpoints. 24 are new routes from system-design §2.3. 5 are existing routes that get extended: POST /api/files (absence-note context), GET /api/me/timetable (sh_child default), GET and PUT /api/attendance/register (EXCUSED pre-fill and rule, absent-notification suppression) and POST /api/internal/email/dispatch (consentReminders). There are also 3 non-HTTP contracts: the notification types, getSelectedChild, and the pure helpers.

The base path is /api, not /api/v1. Envelopes, paginated() meta and error codes come from src/server/http.ts. http.ts has no 422, so system-design's '422' business-rule failures map to 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with details.reason (OUTSIDE_BOOKING_WINDOW, PAST_DUE, SIGNATURE_MISMATCH, DATE_WINDOW).

Error policy: an unviewable student or resource returns 404. A visible resource the caller may not act on returns 403 with details.reason. Races return 409 with details.reason (SLOT_TAKEN, OVERLAP, ONE_PER_TEACHER, ALREADY_REVIEWED, SLOT_BOOKED). The remind throttle returns 429 with retryAfterMs.

Decisions made beyond system-design: GET /api/conferences/:id/slots?view=day serves the teacher day view (FR-34). Slot booking details are hidden from anyone except the booker, the teacher and ADMIN. GET /api/students/:id/overview accepts ?cards= to limit which cards load. PATCH /api/conferences/:id returns 409 if booked slots exist and slotMinutes or date changes. The tracking CSV ignores pagination.
Partial requirements carried from system-design: FR-13 (announcements returns []), FR-35 and the calendar part of FR-5 (no PRD-14 calendar page). Neither is a blocker.

Three schema columns go beyond the PRD (ADR-3): ConferenceSlot.blocked, ConsentForm.lastRemindedAt and ConsentForm.dueReminderSentAt. The migration also adds a raw-SQL partial unique index on ConferenceSlot(eventId, teacherId, bookedForStudentId).
src/lib/validators/{absence-notes,conferences,consent-forms}.ts should mirror the input shapes in api-contracts.json `components`.
artifacts/architect/threat-model-notes.json is still the stale SH-14 file. No architect sub-task owns it, so treat it as out of date.
